messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — sprint cutover this Friday 06:00–10:00 UTC. Plan is staggered micro-deploys + progressive smoke checks. Please claim owners and confirm rollback readiness. I'll coordinate rollouts.

jon: Taking service-auth 06:00–06:45 UTC. I'll run smoke + perf sanity.

li: I can take service-search 07:00–07:45. Will validate embeddings pipeline.

raj: Service-ingest has a DB migration. Need 08:15 slot so migrations finish. I want a second pair of eyes on migration-runner.

ashley: I can pair with Raj on migration verification and rollback.

maya: Nice. Here's current slate — adjust if needed:

``` 
06:00-06:45 service-auth  -> jon (smoke: jon)
07:00-07:45 service-search -> li  (smoke: li)
08:15-09:00 service-ingest -> raj (smoke: raj + ashley)
09:15-09:45 service-api    -> maya (smoke: maya)
```

maya: Rollback plan: tag +1 deploy, and `kubectl rollout undo` per svc; if DB migration applied, run rollback-runner v2 and alert @sre-oncall.

jon: Note — auth has a feature flag gate. Will ensure off for canary users.

li: One request: can we compress search index rebuild to background job? If not, I'll pad the slot.

raj: db migration is non-destructive, but I built a client check script:

```
./tools/migration-check --preview --db prod-readonly
# output: <summary>
```

ashley: I'll run migration-check 1 hour before raj's slot and post results.

deploy-bot: Slot reserved: maya for 06:00 (ID: slot-2173456789-1)

sre-oncall: I'll be on call during the window. If latency spikes > 200ms for p95, ping channel and escalate.

maya: Thanks. Action items:
- jon/li/raj/ashley confirm here by EOD Thu
- post smoke run results in this thread
- attach rollback commands used during the deploy

jon: Confirmed.

li: Confirmed, will also leave a short runbook note.

raj: Confirmed, adding migration-check output after run.

ashley: Confirmed.

maya: Sweet. If anyone needs to swap slots, drop a note and cc @maya. :rocket:
